description: Create the foundational project structure: Next.js App Router config, TailwindCSS setup, global styles with dark mode, layout with metadata/SEO, shared components (Navbar with blur effect and mobile hamburger menu), and all dummy data files for commodities, provinces, weather, and news.
steps: Create package.json with dependencies: next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, framer-motion, recharts, lucide-react, @types/react, @types/node, typescript
Create next.config.js with standard Next.js 14 configuration
Create tsconfig.json with path aliases (@/ pointing to root)
Create tailwind.config.ts with custom theme (colors for agritech branding - emerald/green primary, dark mode class strategy, custom fonts)
Create app/globals.css with Tailwind directives, CSS variables for dark/light mode, glassmorphism utility classes, custom scrollbar styles
Create app/layout.tsx as root layout with Inter font, metadata for SEO (title: NusaTani - AI Agriculture Intelligence Platform Indonesia), dark mode provider wrapper, Navbar component

Create components/navbar.tsx - sticky navbar with backdrop-blur, logo 'NusaTani', menu items (Dashboard, Komoditas, Provinsi, AI Assistant, Cuaca, Berita), responsive mobile hamburger menu with Framer Motion animation, smooth hover effects, dark mode toggle
Create components/ui/button.tsx - reusable button component with variants (primary emerald, secondary, ghost)
Create components/ui/card.tsx - reusable card component with glassmorphism effect
Create lib/utils.ts - utility functions (cn classname merger, formatNumber, formatCurrency)
Create data/commodities.ts - dummy data for commodities (Gabah, Jagung, Singkong, Cabai, Jahe) with prices, percentage changes, historical price arrays for charts
Create data/provinces.ts - dummy data for provinces (Jawa Barat, Jawa Tengah, Jawa Timur, NTB, Sumatera Barat) with production stats
Create data/weather.ts - dummy weather data (temperature, humidity, rainfall, recommendations)
Create data/news.ts - dummy news articles (6 items with titles, categories, dates, thumbnails, content)
Create data/stats.ts - national agriculture statistics (Produksi Gabah, Jagung, Singkong, Total Provinsi Aktif)
Create components/footer.tsx - clean minimal footer with NusaTani branding
acceptance_criteria: All config files (package.json, next.config.js, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js) are valid and properly configured
app/layout.tsx renders Navbar and provides dark mode support
Navbar has all 6 menu items, responsive hamburger menu, blur effect styling
All dummy data files export typed arrays/objects with realistic Indonesian agriculture data
Reusable UI components (button, card) support variants and dark mode
File imports between modules use consistent @/ path aliases
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit to check TypeScript validity (if tsc available)
Verify all imported files exist by checking cross-references
Confirm tailwind.config.ts has darkMode: 'class' and custom emerald/green theme colors
findings: All 17 source files created successfully. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network means no npm install or next build possible. All cross-file imports verified to resolve correctly. TypeScript types defined for all data structures. Dark mode toggle implemented in navbar with class strategy.
